output.question: What is Apple's annual revenue?
output.answer: Apple's most recent annual revenue is $478.8 billion ($478,834 million) for fiscal year 2026, which ended September 26, 2026. Apple reported the figure on November 2, 2026. That is about 15% more than the $416.2 billion ($416,161 million) it reported for fiscal 2025, and Apple calls it an all-time record. Net income for fiscal 2026 was $132.2 billion, and revenue for the September quarter (Q4) alone was $114.5 billion, up 12% year over year.

key_facts.fact: Total net sales for the twelve months ended September 26, 2026 (fiscal 2026) were $478,834 million, compared with $416,161 million for fiscal 2025.
Net income for fiscal 2026 was $132,175 million, compared with $112,010 million for fiscal 2025.
Revenue for fiscal Q4 2026 (the September quarter) was $114.5 billion ($114,477 million), up 12% year over year. Diluted EPS for the quarter was $2.10.
Apple's CFO called fiscal 2026 revenue of about $479 billion an all-time record.

passages.quote: The Company posted quarterly revenue of $114.5 billion, up 12 percent year over year.
For the full fiscal year, Apple recorded $478.8 billion in sales and $132.2 billion in net income

caveats: This is Apple's fiscal year, which ended September 26, 2026. It is not the calendar year. Trailing-twelve-month revenue will change once the December 2026 quarter is reported.
The full-year figures come from the earnings release (8-K Exhibit 99.1). The audited fiscal 2026 Form 10-K was not checked, though its figures normally match.
Apple's press release rounds the full-year figure to $479 billion. The exact figure in the 8-K table is $478,834 million.
I worked out the roughly 15% year-over-year growth from the 8-K table ($478,834M vs. $416,161M). It was not quoted from a page I opened.
